objective: Introduce a disease-resistance allele of the MHC class I DQB1 gene into Ailuropoda melanoleuca to improve survival during outbreaks of feline immunodeficiency virus (FIV) by targeting a known protective haplotype in captive panda populations.

biological_processes: cytotoxic T-cell recognition of viral peptides
early immune detection of intracellular pathogens
expected_output.desired_change: inclusion of a specific MHC class I DQB1 allele with proven protective function against FIV in other felids
retrieval_targets: MHC class I DQB1 allele sequences from FIV-resistant felid populations
in vivo immune response data during FIV exposure

objective: Introduce a reproductive-fitness allele in Gymnogyps californianus derived from a high-heterozygosity region on chromosome 3 to improve sperm motility and viability under low-oxygen conditions during flight.

target_phenotypes: improved sperm motility and viability under hypoxic conditions
expected_output.desired_change: introduction of a high-heterozygosity allele on chromosome 3 linked to enhanced sperm function

objective: Introduce a disease-resistance allele from an outbred population into the MHC diversity loci of Ailuropoda melanoleuca to restore functional diversity in antigen recognition and reduce susceptibility to fungal infections.
